source: DefiLlama — jeu de données public defillama-datasets.llama.fi/emissions
methode: Les quantités et les dates viennent des tableaux publiés par les projets, repris par DefiLlama. Un déverrouillage en FALAISE est un montant instantané ; un déverrouillage LINÉAIRE est un débit hebdomadaire, et les deux ne s'additionnent pas. La valeur en dollars et la part de capitalisation sont calculées avec le cours et la capitalisation du MÊME cache que les fiches — un rapport dont le numérateur et le dénominateur viennent de deux instants différents est un rapport faux.
avertissement: ⚠ CE CALENDRIER EST DOCUMENTAIRE, JAMAIS VÉRIFIÉ SUR LA CHAÎNE. Il vient des prospectus et des tableaux fournis par les équipes. Mesuré : le champ de vérification en temps réel de la source est vide sur la totalité des jetons collectés, et son champ de sources l'est aussi — les notes citent les documents, jamais une adresse. Une date peut donc être juste sur le papier et fausse dans le contrat, et rien ici ne permettrait de le voir.

notes: Past mining rewards are fetched from Dune Analytics (query 5166006). Future halvenings are forecasted and dates are estimates only.
Information on the Early Contributor vesting schedule structure could not be found, here we have assumed it as linearly unlocked over 4 years.
The Ethereum Foundation supply is assumed to be unlocked when there's an outflow from EthDev address.
Mining Rewards includes Uncle Rewards and pre-merge EIP-1559 burns
Staking Rewards includes post-merge EIP-1559 burns
Initial supply was 200M BNB, distributed as 50% ICO, 40% founding team, 10% angel investors.
Angel investor vesting details were not publicly disclosed, we assumed they were unlocked at launch.
Dead Address Burns tracks native BNB sent to 0x...dead (includes Auto Burns + Community Burns).
Gas Burns tracks BEP-95 real-time fee burns via feeBurned events on BSC Validator Set contract.
Bridge Hack: 2M BNB minted Oct 2022, 1.02M locked on-chain (treated as burned).
6,823 BNB locked in TokenHub contract by user misoperation (treated as burned).
110K BNB from Beacon Chain validators locked during BNB Chain Fusion (treated as burned).
Public Sale and Private Sale are assumed to be unlocked at launch.
Network Rewards are combination of block rewards and voting rewards.
Ongoing Network Rewards (Emissions) started Jan 1, 2021, at a rate of approximately 5.07 million TRX per day (block + voting rewards). Where before it was awarded by the Tron Foundation.
Ongoing emissions are modeled up to 15-year period due to their indefinite nature. The rate is derived from the documented daily emission.
The total supply of TRX is dynamic due to ongoing emissions and burning mechanisms (e.g., for USDD minting). Burning is not modeled.
The emission rate is based on documentation from May 2023 and assumed constant.
Most vesting schedules will complete between 2027–2028; some will continue after 2028. Here we have used an end date of end of 2027.
Although the full allocations for Hyper Foundation Budget and Community Grants were unlocked at TGE it is unclear what their spend rate is.
Validator Rewards are distributed based on staking yield, which may vary over time.
Total staked are fetched from ASXN API to calculate Validator Rewards distribution.
The Core Contributors allocation tracks HYPE tokens transferred from the HyperLabs address to contributors
Block rewards were initially random between 0-1,000,000 DOGE for blocks 1-99,999
Block rewards were random between 0-500,000 DOGE for blocks 100,000-144,999
Fixed block rewards were implemented from block 145,000 onwards
Projected until block 12.5M
25M tokens were burned at TGE, dropping the max supply to 375M

The two Funds allocations have multiple uses (liquidity, ecosystem, team, influencers, treasury) and it isn't clear which sub-categories map to which unlock schedule, so they are grouped together under community
Non-circulating addresses are sourced from Chainlink's official supply API
Node Operators & Company tracked as LINK transfers from non-circulating wallets to external addresses, excluding internal transfers
Community Sale tokens have a 12 to 24 month lockup. Here we have taken an average of 18 months lock up.
~87M Early Ecosystem tokens were provisioned for an unannounced distribution program with no lockup contract. We've modeled it as a cliff at genesis since no lockup existed.
Staking Rewards are queried from Dune
Future halvenings have at a specified block height, therefore the dates shown are an estimate only.
V2 LP staking rewards tracked via RewardPaid events from 4 historical staking contracts
Merkl incentives tracked via NewCampaign events, amortized over campaign duration
Exact dates for Seed and Private sales couldn't be found, so we've given them the latest dates described.
Staking rewards are sourced from on-chain P-Chain supply data via the Glacier API.
Burns are not included.
Tracks daily minting rewards split across app, validator, and super validator categories.
Future issuance is projected linearly through 2029, when the next scheduled Super Validator reward reduction is expected.
Future halvenings have at a specified block height, therefore the dates shown are an estimate only.
Data shown is from a CSV supplied by Ethena on 20 May 2024.

Airdrops (S1, S2, S3) are modeled as separate sections subtracted from Ecosystem Development to reflect distributions as allocated/owned tokens per oFDV principles, ensuring max supply remains exactly 15B ENA.

S1 (Shard Campaign): 750M ENA total. Immediate: ~428M (non-top wallets 100% + top 2000 immediate 50%). Vested: ~322M (top 2000 50% over 6 months). Assumptions: Exact splits based on historical claims; vesting linearized monthly for simplicity (official is weekly).

S2 (Sats Campaign): 750M ENA total. Immediate: ~578M (non-largest wallets 100% + largest 2000 immediate 50%). Vested: ~171M (largest 2000 50% over 6 months). Assumptions: As above; start month adjusted to match CSV bumps.

S3: 525M ENA total (3.5% supply). Immediate: ~438M (assumed 83.3%: top 2000 immediate 2/3 + non-top 100%). Vested: ~88M (assumed 16.7%: top 2000 1/3 over 6 months, with top ~50% of total allocation). Assumptions: Proportions estimated from announcement (top vesting 1/3, no exact top/non-top split public); monthly linear (official weekly). Update if precise data available.
Top 2000 wallet vesting: No public list of exact wallets or per-wallet amounts, so modeled as aggregate linear unlocks.
General: Rounding applied for integer totals; minor discrepancies (~1-5M) may occur from vesting distribution.
8.8% of the total supply was airdropped at TGE, the remaining airdrop allocation will be used for future community distributions.
The treasury allocation will not enter circulating supply after TGE and remain fully locked until utilized via governance-approved mechanisms
Ecosystem emissions were originally a 20-month linear unlock at 78.4M/month on BSC. In Jan 2026 this was replaced by a staking-only model on Aster Chain at 450K ASTER per weekly epoch
We've only modelled the Ecosystem emissions up to 2030
Treasury Outflows tracks Mantle tokens transferred out of the Mantle DAO Treasury addresses
Since these tokens are used for multiple purposes, we've categorized them as 'Other'
This schedule covers the 5B tokens mined at TGE, the rest of the supply will be mined through block rewards.
URD Rewards: actual MORPHO claimed on the legacy (pre-Merkl) Universal Rewards Distributors, aggregated per day.

Merkl Campaigns: DAO-only Merkl campaigns (creatorTag=morpho) across all chains, distributed per-day from each campaign's amount over its active duration. Excludes third-party MORPHO campaigns routed through the same Merkl infrastructure.
There's no vesting schedule for the Foundation, Team & Partnerships allocation, so we've assumed it was unlocked at genesis
Network Rewards includes voting rewards, node provider rewards, and burns (net supply change)
The Arbitrum DAO Treasury tracks the ARB outflows of the DAO treasury address: 0xF3FC178157fb3c87548bAA86F9d24BA38E649B58
Circulating supply is lower than the unlocked amount because of multiple burns which are not included here.
Staking Rewards and Treasury Mints are tracked on-chain via VVV Transfer events from the zero address.
Data provided by Jupiter team.
3 billion JUP was burned on 2025-01-26, split equally between the team and community allocations (1.5 billion each), reducing the max supply from 10 billion to 7 billion.

A further 136,761,146.18 JUP has been burned across two programs: the Litterbox burn of 134,549,950.92 (2025-11-25), and VRFD fee burns totalling 2,211,195.26 (191,099.76 on 2025-09-03, 473,210 on 2025-11-25, and 1,546,885.50 on 2026-04-24). Jupiter's reported total supply is 6,863,238,853.82 JUP. These burns are not modeled as events, so supply figures here run ~136.76M higher.

The Net-Zero proposal passed by DAO vote in February 2026, taking JUP net emissions to effectively zero: Jupuary postponed with the tokens returned to the Community Cold Multisig pending a future DAO vote, Team Reserve emissions paused indefinitely, and Mercurial Stakeholders vesting accelerated.

Allocations with no scheduled unlock are held as TBD sections, tokens remaining in protocol custody: Team (~427.78M, paused), Mercurial Stakeholders (~82.45M), and Jupuary (1.4B — 700M postponed from 2026, 700M reserve with no airdrops planned).
Community Reserves (300M) and Strategic Reserve (1,332.7M) have no defined unlock schedule and are marked as TBD.

Active Staking Rewards (ASR) continues at 50M JUP per quarter to stakers. It is not modeled as a separate emission event: it is distributed from LFG Launchpad fees and previously unclaimed Jupuary and does not create new emissions. Non-JUP ASR payouts (ZEUS, UPT, SHARK, WEN, CLOUD, DBR) are outside this adapter.
Mining Reserve distribution is TBD.
Baseline Minting are assumed to be linear for simplicity
Simple Minting are assumed to be linear with the supply getting halved every 6 years
After Epoch 67, emissions are controlled by the Aero Fed where veAERO voters decide to increase, decrease, or maintain emission rates.

Sections Airdrop for veVELO Lockers, Ecosystem Pairs and Public Goods, Team Initial Mint, and Protocol Grants are distributed as veAERO (vote-locked). Auto Max-Locked portions remain locked for 4 years unless auto-max-lock is disabled. These sections are marked TBD as unlock depends on individual lock expiry.
Gauge, Rebase and Team Emissions are tracked onchain.
The ecosystem allocation will be used for future points seasons, partnerships and growth initiatives.
The remaining 13.3% of Community Allocation have no defined unlock schedule and are marked as TBD.
The LayerZero Foundation bought back 50M tokens from early investors, reducing the original Strategic Partners allocation
The original 40M Tokens Repurchased were clawed back in a settlement with the FTX Estate and are now included in the Strategic Partners allocation.

Staking rewards follow Aptos' declining inflation schedule: 7% at launch, decreasing 1.5% per year to a 3.25% floor. Emissions are modeled monthly with compounding and calibrated against actual on-chain supply.

pancakeswap-token.offre_incoherente: La source ne publie pas d’offre de référence pour ce calendrier. Les parts en pourcentage sont donc absentes : elles n’auraient pas de dénominateur. Les quantités de jetons, elles, restent exactes.
notes: Tracks only user-facing CAKE emissions (farming, staking, ecosystem).
Burns are not included — they reduce supply from protocol revenue and are accounted for separately.
Product-level breakdown available from Sept 2021 onward.
CAKE has a maximum supply of 450 million tokens.
The Contingency Fund allocation is held for ongoing network maintenance and operational needs, we've marked it as TBD.
The Pre-Placement allocation was distributed to early investors and exchanges
Staking rewards are estimated from daily block counts (via XDCScan). Each epoch is 900 blocks, and 250 XDC is minted per epoch as validator rewards.
Celestia’s 1 billion TIA supply at genesis will be subject to several different unlock schedules. All tokens, locked or unlocked, may be staked, but staking rewards are unlocked upon receipt.

Inflation started at 8% annually, decreasing by 10%/year. CIP-29 in July 2025 dropped it to ~5.0% with 6.7%/year disinflation. CIP-41 in November 2025 dropped it further to ~2.5% with 6.7%/year disinflation, until reaching a 1.5% terminal rate.
ETHFI claims tracked via Claimed events from MerkleDistributor and Liquid ETH Rewards contracts
Scroll cashback tracked via Cashback events from CashEventEmitter (weETH token)
Incentive pool emissions have been estimated based on info in the source materials.
It cant be known when future team members will join, so this section (1.5% of total) has been excluded from the analysis.
Community emissions are the CRV actually minted to gauge stakers on claim. CRV accrued in gauges but not yet claimed is not counted until it is minted, and no future emissions are projected.
CRV has no hard cap. The 3.03B figure is the asymptotic total of the inflation schedule plus the 1.3B initial supply.
The Foundation & Ecosystem Growth, Future Incentives and Router Rewards allocations don't have a specific unlock schedule, so we used a linear schedule
The Ecosystem allocation sits in a DAO-controlled multisig and it's deployed only after receiving governance approval
PENDLE gauge incentives tracked via MarketClaimReward events from GaugeController contracts across 9 chains
Old LP mining incentives tracked via PendleRewardsSettled V1 (4 contracts) and V2 (11 contracts) on Ethereum
Merkle distributor incentives tracked via Claimed events from PendleMerkleDistributor on Ethereum
Other Incentives are tokens minted to the Liquidity Incentives Multisig contract that haven't been claimed or distributed
Tezos Foundation and DLS (Team) allocations vested monthly over 4 years.
The 4-year vesting period for Foundation and Team concluded on September 17, 2022.
Actual Tezos inflation is adaptive and changes based on the network staking ratio but for simplicity, we assume a constant rate of 5.5%.
We are tracking LDO token distribution from known wallets as incentives
Total supply inflates at 2% per year but the documentation doesnt describe how they're allocated.
The Governance fund, airdrops, RPGF, Partner fund and Seed fund have portions with no defined unlock schedule, so they are shown as TBD.
The supply of Basic Attention Token (BAT) has fully vested.
Early Backers & Backers allocations are locked up ranging from 6 months to 2 years, but in this case we are assumming that early backers are unlocked after 6 months and backers after 12 months.
Public GRT Sale is vague, but it is assumed that it is unlocked at TGE.
Graph Foundation allocation at start is 4.6% and the rest is assumed to be unlocked over 10 years
New Issuance increases the supply by 3% per year and modeled for 10 years, but this can be changed in the future.
Programmatic Incentives are tracked from rewards claimed onchain
The Growth Triggered Unlocks allocation has 37.5% of the total supply. These tokens are progressively unlocked as Backpack hits regulatory, product, and market milestones.
All the tokens from the Growth Triggered Unlocks allocation go directly to users
The Corporate Treasury (37.5%) is fully locked until 1 year post-IPO and is not included as an allocation since the IPO date is not known yet.

From the chart given in the source material, Jito estimate ~6 year linear vesting schedule for Community Growth and Ecosystem Development sections. Therefore we have used the same in this analysis, For the Community Growth section, we have used the Jito DAO token outflow data to estimate the vesting schedule.
Tokens for core contributors and launch advisors will have a four year lock-up and vesting schedule.
The Unclaimed Tokens allocation was removed from circulation until valid claims are processed.
Staking rewards (767k IOTA/epoch) began at the Rebase upgrade on May 5, 2025.
Locked tokens from the Stardust vesting schedule can be delegated to validators to earn staking rewards.
Tracks circulating RUNE over time: investor/team/community allocations (vested by 2023) plus node & pool emissions from the reserve. Sections sum to the current circulating supply, ~338.3M.

Post-burn max supply was 500M RUNE (reduced from ~968M in 2019). Since then ~145.8M has been burned and the undistributed reserve (~16M, noncirculating) is excluded, so the schedule tracks circulating supply rather than the 500M cap.

Reserve burns (ADR-12 ~60M and ADR-23 ~64.4M) came out of the reserve before it was emitted, so node & pool emissions total ~72.65M rather than the full ~221M reserve allocation. Those tokens never circulated and are not counted as unlocked.

Circulating-supply burns are netted into the section figures rather than shown as separate events: the killswitch burn (~13.9M) is netted into Public & Private Sale (73.65M), and ongoing system-income burns are netted into POL & Ops fees.
Node & pool emissions split into block rewards (incentive) and POL & Ops fees (not an incentive).

The Meteora Reserve allocation will be vested over 6 years, tokens in this bucket are to be used as liquidity mining rewards after TGE, to be strategically leveraged by the Meteora Team to attract liquidity providers
The Meteora Reserve unlocks track the tokens transferred out of the Meteora Reserve $MET token account: 2efFfkUNuSRpBqjNTu5Mr6Czhecd5jFF6NkxhEJA4hGF
INST token was rebranded to FLUID, no allocations changed
40M community allocation sent to DAO treasury at TGE, distributed over time
Airdrop tracks actual claims from genesis merkle distributors
~8.61M unclaimed airdrop tokens were returned to the DAO treasury
Community Incentives tracks treasury net outflows excluding airdrop distributor returns to avoid double-counting
DAO Treasury (TBD) tracks FLUID tokens still held by the DAO Treasury
The schedule is based on the provided table data from docs.
Subsequent amounts listed against '90 days after' rows are interpreted as the total amount released linearly over the 90-day period ending at that point in time.
Curve LP rewards (50%) tracked via CVX mint events from zero address
Ecosystem Initiatives (19.90%) are minted on demand with no set unlock schedule. We have set it as TBD.
No tokens will be minted for Token Assembly (29.27%) until governance is live. We have set it as TBD.
In this analysis we've assumed Team and Investors allocations unlock in equal proportions at the cliff.
Inflationary emissions to reward contributors and stakers are proposed but not yet live
Treasury funds spent before migration from MC to BEAM have been interpolated with a linear schedule.
The total supply represents the maximum posible supply of BEAM if all MC holders migrate to BEAM
The Private TVL Deals allocation (3.75% of total supply) doesn't have a defined unlock schedule, so it is marked as TBD
The remaining portion of the Ecosystem & Community allocation (37.37% of total supply) doesn't have a defined unlock schedule, it is marked as TBD
All the allocations are tracked onchain
Burns are deducted from the mining allocation
The max supply of this token is capped at 1,000,000,000. The supply of Golem (GLM) has fully unlocked.
No Advisors unlock schedule is given, here we have assumed it is the same as the Investors unlock schedule.
An unknown proportion of Checkers & Compute Providers allocation is released according to Reward Schedules. Here we have used the same 4 year linear unlock as the rest of this allocation.
Checker Node Rewards tracks ATH withdrawn after the claim vesting period; rewards earned but not yet claimed or still vesting are not included. Claim amounts are net of early-withdraw penalties.
Aquafarm and Whirlpool incentives are tracked onchain
The treasury burned 25M tokens, dropping the total supply to 75M
Staking Rewards are from Safety Module (DYDX stakers), Farming Incentives are from trading rewards and liquidity staking (USDC)
The Community Treasury allocation vests at a rate of 3.78M tokens per epoch
Inflation starts at 3.5% and decreases 10% anually. It will stabilize once the network reaches 1% inflation. We have modelled the inflation until 2041
40% of the yearly inflation goes to delegators and validators, 60% goes to different treasury buckets
The Foundation and Protocol Growth & Rewards allocations don't have a vesting schedule, they are marked as TBD.
esGMX is distributed to GMX stakers, GLP LPs, and affiliates, then vested into GMX over 1 year via vester contracts.
The Floor Price Fund allocation was originally 2M, but a governance proposal repurposed 1M for esGMX rewards
